summary.text: Ed George is the Libertarian candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 34, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Tim Longest (D).

paragraphs.text: George ran for the same seat in 2024 as the Libertarian nominee and lost the general election to Longest, who received 75.8 percent of the vote to George's 24.2 percent.

sources.title: North Carolina House of Representatives elections, 2026
